sentences.text: The Sentinels are the part of the Order of Steering that audits individual businesses,

sentences.quote: each audit assigning a particular business a position on a particular rubric

sentences.text: They repeat a tenth of Acolytes' audits to score them, and because they act on specific things in the world,

sentences.quote: Sentinels are the people everyone is trying to influence
